bren.direction: An original male fantasy RPG protagonist in his mid twenties. Youthful natural mid-low speaking voice, subtle gravel on stressed words, warm and grounded, impulsive and quietly angsty. A brave young adult carrying frustration and responsibility beneath a dry sense of humor. Intimate believable acting, conversational short phrases, flexible emotion, relaxed neutral English with a light British inflection. Never a booming trailer announcer, no old man's bass or forced theatrical growl. Pristine dry studio audio.

soren.direction: An original male fantasy scholar mage in his mid twenties, intelligent and guarded. A youthful clear mid register with a slightly breathy edge and precise soft consonants. Thoughtful, emotionally conflicted, restrained angst and uneasy warmth when speaking to his closest friend. Natural contemporary dramatic acting, conversational pace with subtle hesitations, neutral English lightly British. Distinct from a rugged warrior: leaner, smoother, intimate. No narration, caricature or elderly voice. Pristine dry studio recording.

tavin.direction: An original male ranger in his late twenties. Youthful but grounded, warm rounded low-mid voice with a gentle husky edge, wry protective confidence and understated impatience. Natural English, conversational British inflection. A practical friend who has seen trouble, not an old mentor or radio host. Intimate nuanced dramatic performance, easy phrasing and real emotion instead of a fantasy announcer delivery. Pristine dry studio audio.

mira.direction: An original young adult woman healer in her mid twenties. Warm confident mezzo speaking voice, naturally textured and softly husky, emotionally intelligent with a stubborn, slightly sardonic edge. Compassion with urgency and frustration, never saccharine or motherly. Conversational natural English with a light British inflection, intimate believable dramatic acting and varied cadence. Clear articulate words without advertising-style brightness. Pristine dry studio audio.

lysa.direction: An original young adult woman mage in her early twenties. Clear lively mid-high speaking voice with a lightly smoky edge, sharp wit, impatient resolve and vulnerable youthful angst. Bright but not squeaky, confident but never a cartoon. Natural conversational English lightly British, nuanced dramatic game acting, expressive phrasing and short purposeful breaths. No narrator cadence. Pristine dry studio audio.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Hold Shift as you move to sprint. Release Shift to return to your usual running pace.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Follow the gold arrow to the local representative. When you are close, press E, or click the highlighted interaction button.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Run across the bridge using W A S D, the arrow keys, or click clear ground. Your companions will follow your route.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: The gate is open. Follow the arrow to the pump, and interact. Soren can use magic to repair it.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Follow the arrow up the stone steps to the jammed gate. Interact with its crank, and Bren will use his strength to free it.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Open Inventory using I, or the highlighted button. Choose Supplies to see herbs for health, tinctures for magic, and revival draughts.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Open Equipment. Select a companion to inspect their weapon and armor fittings. You can buy new fittings at the smithy.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Open Party to inspect each companion. Select Bren or Soren to see their health, magic, level, and role.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Open Abilities. Read your companions’ skills and magic costs. Offensive skills target enemies; healing and protection target allies.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Open the Journal to review the current story objective. Optional local requests have a separate page, and open after you help Brookstead.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Open the map with M. This is the same landscape you can explore. Drag to pan, right-drag to rotate, and scroll to zoom.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: You are ready. Follow the arrow to the crossed swords on the outer-yard floor, then interact to protect the residents.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Select an enemy by clicking its sprite or name. The arrow marks your target. Choose Attack, then strike when the indicator reaches gold.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Press Space, E, or the Strike button as the indicator crosses the gold window. Each successful timing continues your attack chain.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: On your next turn, choose Skills. Select an ability and its target. Abilities spend magic points, so check the cost before committing.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Choose Defend to reduce the next incoming damage. Sometimes protecting a companion matters more than one extra attack.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Choose Items, then select the companion who needs help. Herbs restore health, tinctures restore magic, and revival draughts revive fallen allies.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Review your rewards, then choose View Growth to see each companion’s experience. Continue Journey applies the rewards once and returns you to the world.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: The local representative is coming to speak with you. He will explain what Brookstead has learned, and where your investigation leads next.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Before the next road, visit the inn. Its blue chronicle circle lets you save your journey. Recording is available only inside inns.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Clouds, wind, rain, and daylight change as you travel. Rain darkens stone and leaves puddles. You can adjust motion and sound in Settings.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: When the story awakens a companion’s Light, a full charge allows Ascension. Ascended abilities are stronger, and last for a limited time in combat.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Leave by a ground exit to reach the overworld. Enter a settlement at its ground arrows. Discovered places allow fast travel from the map.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Choose Attack. Bren will move into range and begin a three-strike chain.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: This first encounter will teach you one action at a time. Nothing attacks while you read. Start with Bren, then try Soren's magic, healing, and defense.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Choose the Duskfang Wolf. Click its name or its sprite, or focus its name with the keyboard and press Enter. The gold arrow marks your selected foe.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: For this first strike, the marker waits inside the gold window. Press Space, E, or the Strike button. The next two strikes run more slowly so you can practice timing them yourself.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: The wolf is preparing to hit Bren. Watch his HP bar on the right. After the hit, we'll use a healing herb.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Now choose Skills, then Arcane pulse. This spends eight magic points. Watch Soren's MP bar and the selected enemy's health.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Choose Defend. It reduces the next incoming hit without spending magic. Watch how much less damage Bren takes this time.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Bren is hurt. Choose Items, then Healing herb, then Bren. A practice herb is provided for this lesson, so your own supplies are kept.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: Bren is braced. The same attack now deals less damage. Guarding can buy the time you need to heal or prepare your next move.

lines.speaker: World voice
lines.text: You know the essentials. Select your foes, time attack chains, watch HP and MP, use items when needed, and defend against incoming damage. Finish driving the wildlife away.
